title: Inventory counting notice
passage: The warehouse will conduct its quarterly inventory count on Friday afternoon. Material requests needed for Friday's production must reach us by eleven in the morning. From noon to four, we will handle safety emergencies only. Team leaders should assign one person to confirm quantities with warehouse staff. For sealed boxes, use the quantity on the label unless the seal is damaged. Regular material pickup starts again at four thirty in the afternoon.
passageZh: 倉庫將在星期五下午進行季度盤點。星期五生產所需的領料申請必須在上午十一點前送達。中午到下午四點，只處理緊急安全事件。各組主管應指派一人與倉庫人員核對數量。有封條的紙箱，若封條未破損，請依標籤上的數量盤點。下午四點半恢復正常領料。
